name: Megaloblastic B12 Folate Pernicious Long Case

reference.source: Long Cases in Clinical Medicine (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: B12 or folate lack stalls DNA synthesis producing hypersegmented megaloblasts with ineffective haemolysis; B12 loss demyelinates dorsal and lateral columns, and folate-alone replacement masks anaemia while cords degenerate.
additionalDifferentials: B12 versus folate versus pernicious versus MDS by neuro MMA antibodies and blasts
Diet versus pernicious versus drugs by vegan IF and meds
Dementia versus primary by B12 and reversibility
additionalInvestigations: B12 MMA with folate LDH antibodies
